Strategy: Apply the sweet-band reward between forty and fifty-five only when at least five bins are open, keeping the mid penalty always on. This combines the shifted-up band with the best gate, but both the band and the gate are guesses.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if len(bins) >= 5 and r - item >= 40 and r - item <= 55 else 0) - (20 if r - item >= 8 and r - item <= 22 else 0) for r in bins]
```
